checklist.title: Own synthetic service rubric
checklist.description: Fictional conversations. Company facts and audio are not verified.

criteria.title: LOCAL_GREETING
criteria.instruction: Yes if the first operator response greets and introduces themselves in the customer language. A bot greeting does not count.

criteria.title: LOCAL_IDENTITY
criteria.instruction: Yes if identity verification occurs before a protected account action.
criteria.na_rule: Only a general public question is asked, without a protected account action.

criteria.title: LOCAL_CLARITY
criteria.instruction: Rate understandable wording using the configured levels, independently of politeness and external company facts.

levels.description: Clear, understandable wording. Assess clarity separately from politeness and factual correctness.

criteria.title: LOCAL_GROSS
criteria.instruction: Yes if the operator explicitly insults the client; no otherwise. A separate weightless violation flag.
